- `separate-review-stage` (reconsider): absent; reject; also in doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/autonomous-run.md (variant); reason: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours sizes review to risk: AGENTS.md matches review to uncertainty and consequences, and the implement playbook's light path has the coordinator check acceptance, verification and the diff, invoking substantive review only when needed, while its full path uses independent review. An autonomous run attempts a closeout critic that reads the run's whole diff cold, and reports `not reviewed` with a reason when the critic is unreachable. A separate review stage for every implementation is an absolute rule for a choice that depends on the work (S-08) (AGENTS.md:39-40; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/implement/task-engine.md:65-72; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/autonomous-run.md:123-126).

Moving enforcement to the reviewer alone would drop the implementer's part (AGENTS.md:102; AGENTS.md:56-58; .claude/skills/review/references/code.md:41-45).

- `review-time-standards-file` (reconsider): absent; reject; reason: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation.
